info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Wholesale Trading Market Order-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of market orders within the wholesale trading sector. It allows businesses to efficiently manage their wholesale transactions by placing orders that respond to market conditions. Typical consumers include trading firms and financial institutions looking to streamline their order processing and trading strategies. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their operational capabilities, ensuring timely and accurate execution of market orders.

post.summary: Create a new market order in wholesale trading.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new market order within the wholesale trading system. Ensure all required parameters are filled accurately to process the order successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new market order in the wholesale trading system. It requires the details of the market order such as the instrument, quantity, and price.

201.description: Resource successfully created for the market order.
